protocol: Not the full CICIDS2017 table. Every MachineLearningCSV file is streamed. A reservoir sample keeps at most 20000 BENIGN rows and 20000 attack rows (seed 42). Infinite or missing values are dropped before sampling. The sample is split 80/20 into train and test, stratified on the attack bit. CICIDS2017 has no official train/test files, so this split is defined here. Destination Port stays in the features as a number. One-class. One-Class SVM (RBF, nu=0.01) is fit on at most 4000 BENIGN rows from the CICIDS train sample. The test sample is not reduced again.
